title: Notch1 signaling regulates Sox9 and VEGFA expression and governs BMP2-induced endochondral ossification of mesenchymal stem cells.
authors: Zou, Jing; Du, Chengcheng; Liu, Senrui; Zhao, Piao; Gao, Shengqiang; Chen, Bowen; Wu, Xiangdong; Huang, Wei; Zhu, Zhenglin; Liao, Junyi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Notch1信号调控BMP2诱导的间充质干细胞成骨分化，虽涉及转录因子RBPjk与Sox9/VEGFA启动子结合，但核心是细胞分化表型而非TF-DNA互作建模，且方法以实验为主，仅少量分子对接，无AI或物理模拟建模。
abstract: Although bone morphogenetic protein 2 (BMP2) can induce chondrogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), its induction of endochondral ossification limits the application of BMP2-based cartilage regeneration. Here, we clarified the mechanisms of BMP2-induced endochondral ossification of MSCs. In vitro and in vivo chondrogenic, osteogenic, and angiogenic differentiation models of MSCs were constructed. The expression of target genes was identified at both protein and mRNA levels. RNA sequencing, molecular docking, co-immunoprecipitation, and chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing were applied to investigate the molecular mechanisms. We found that BMP2 up-regulated the expression of Notch receptors and ligands in MSCs. Notch1 signaling activation was related to inhibition of chondrogenic differentiation, promotion of osteogenic and angiogenic differentiation. In vivo ectopic stem cell implantation identified that Notch1 signaling activation blocked BMP2-induced chondrogenesis and facilitated endochondral ossification of MSCs. Mechanistically, we elucidated Notch1 intracellular domain (NICD1)-RBPjk complex binding to SRY-box transcription factor 9 (Sox9) and vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFA) promoters to decrease Sox9 expression and increase VEGFA expression. These findings suggest that Notch1 signaling can regulate BMP2-induced endochondral ossification by promoting RBPjk-mediated Sox9 inactivation and VEGFA expression. It is conceivable that targeting Notch1 signaling mediated endochondral ossification would benefit BMP2-based cartilage regeneration.
abstract_zh: 尽管骨形态发生蛋白2（BMP2）能够诱导间充质干细胞（MSCs）的软骨分化，但其诱导的软骨内骨化限制了基于BMP2的软骨再生的应用。在此，我们阐明了BMP2诱导MSCs软骨内骨化的机制。构建了MSCs的体外和体内软骨形成、成骨和血管生成分化模型。在蛋白质和mRNA水平上鉴定了靶基因的表达。应用RNA测序、分子对接、共免疫沉淀和染色质免疫沉淀后测序来研究分子机制。我们发现BMP2上调了MSCs中Notch受体和配体的表达。Notch1信号激活与抑制软骨分化、促进成骨和血管生成分化相关。体内异位干细胞植入实验确定，Notch1信号激活阻断了BMP2诱导的软骨形成，并促进了MSCs的软骨内骨化。机制上，我们阐明了Notch1胞内域（NICD1）-RBPjk复合物结合到SRY-box转录因子9（Sox9）和血管内皮生长因子A（VEGFA）启动子上，从而降低Sox9表达并增加VEGFA表达。这些发现表明，Notch1信号通过促进RBPjk介导的Sox9失活和VEGFA表达来调节BMP2诱导的软骨内骨化。可以设想，靶向Notch1信号介导的软骨内骨化将有利于基于BMP2的软骨再生。
